dedupe_keys.name: temporary dense seismic network during the 2016 central italy seismic emergency for microzonation studies

description: Temporary dense seismic network during the 2016 Central Italy seismic emergency for microzonation studies is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Fabrizio Cara et al. In August 2016, a magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck Central Italy, starting a devastating seismic sequence, aggravated by other two events of magnitude 5.9 and 6.5, respectively. After the first mainshock, four Italian institutions installed a dense temporary network of 50 seismic stations in an area of 260 km2. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2019. Formats: PDF, miniSEED. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC BY 4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
